string.text: !DynSnow
DynSnow v1.6 for G.A.M.M.A.
Always Snowing (100% Outdoor Snowfall)
Keeps rich snowfall active at all times outdoors (when Project INVERNO is installed), cycling smoothly between thick snowflakes, heavy snow, and blizzards without dry clear gaps.
Enable Subtle Frost & Snow Dusting on Weapons
Accumulates delicate, crystalline rime frost and fine snow grains on upward-facing weapon ridges and crevices outdoors, shaking slightly on recoil and melting indoors or near campfires.
Weapon Frost & Snow Intensity
Adjusts the amount of rime frost and snow crystals settling on top of your 1st-person weapon (1.0 = subtle Project INVERNO look).
NPC & Mutant Surface Snow Intensity (0.0 = Off)
Controls surface snow accumulation on Stalkers, NPCs, and Mutants independently of world objects. Set to 0.0 to completely disable snow on characters and mutants (Default: 0.25).
Vehicles, Roofs & World Objects Snow Intensity (0.0 = Off)
Controls surface snow accumulation on cars, trucks, roofs, rocks, barrels, crates, and buildings independently of NPCs and mutants (0.0 = Off, 1.0 = Default, 2.0 = Heavy).
Enable Full-Map 3D Volumetric Snow Trenches
Carves real-time 3D parallax snow trenches with raised side berms visible across the entire map that stay for 5+ minutes and gradually snow back over from start to end.
Enable Stalker & Mutant 3D Snow Trenches
Stalkers and mutants across the entire map carve real 3D snow trenches that stay for 5+ minutes and slowly fill in from oldest tail to newest head.
3D Snow Trench Duration Multiplier (1.0 = 5-6 Min)
Controls how long 3D snow trenches persist before falling snow fills them back in from start to end (1.0 = 5.0 min in blizzards up to 6.0 min in normal snowfall).
Enable Smooth 3D Campfire Snow Melting & Re-Snowing
Lit campfires smoothly and continuously melt surrounding 3D snow outward into thawed soil and slush. When extinguished, snowfall smoothly buries the firepit again.
Campfire Snow Melt Radius (Meters)
Maximum radius around a burning campfire where 3D snow smoothly melts away.
Enable Snow Dust & Tree Branch Snow Cascades
Sprinting, landings, gunshots, and explosions kick up snow dust and shake falling snow cascades loose from tree canopies.
